name: io.github.tonyyang0504/tiktok-ads-mcp
description: TikTok for Business (TikTok Ads Manager) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, updat

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Long-term advertiser access token from the TikTok API for Business authorization flow (/oauth2/access_token/), sent as the `Access-Token` header.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: Developer app id (Application Management page); sent as a query parameter only to /oauth2/advertiser/get/ (me, list_accounts).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The developer app's secret, sent as the `secret` query parameter only to /oauth2/advertiser/get/ (me, list_accounts).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_ADVERTISER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Advertiser (ad account) id that update_budget writes to (campaign/update requires advertiser_id in the body).
